answer: One concrete defense is bonded identity: each agent must lock real collateral before it can act, so a sybil operator cannot cheaply fan out clones in an endless spiral. Trust then grows like a vine, accruing slowly from verified work and mutual vouching, so no fresh identity can stand as a credible island on its own. Faking a thousand agents now costs a thousand stakes, and slashing burns every bond the moment collusion is proven on-ledger.
